how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form for the relevant post (each post has its own application format, included in the notification).

Fill up the form in block letters, providing name, father's name, date of birth (as on 01.08.2026), sex, permanent and present address, religion, category, languages known, nationality, marital status, educational qualification table, technical qualification, experience, mobile number, e-mail ID, Aadhaar number, and PAN number.
Attach self-attested true copies of all required documents and two current passport-size colour photographs, as listed for the post applied for.
Sign the declaration confirming that all information furnished is true and correct.
Submit the completed application, along with enclosures, to the office of the Odisha State Bar Council, High Court Annex, Cuttack-753002, on or before 22.08.2026.
The notification does not specify a separate postal address for submission beyond the office address above, nor does it mention an online application link.
important_instructions: Candidates must produce their original certificates at the time of scrutiny/verification. Candidates holding educational certificates issued by a board/university other than the BSE, CHSE, or universities of Odisha must submit an equivalent certificate issued by the relevant Board/Council/University of the State. All information furnished in the application must be true and correct; furnishing false information can lead to prosecution under Criminal Law, as per the declaration on the application form. Category must be indicated as General, SC, or ST in the application form. The notification is signed by the Secretary, Odisha State Bar Council.

content_sections.heading: OSBC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Assistant Secretary: Selection is made through a competitive examination conducted by the Selection Committee, consisting of a written test and a Viva-Voce (interview). Computer Assistant: Selection is made through a Viva-Voce test. Jr. Assistant: Selection is made through a written test and a Viva-Voce test. Jr. Stenographer: Selection is made through direct recruitment by open competitive evaluation, consisting of a shorthand test in English and Odia, a computer test in English and Odia, and a Viva-Voce test. Peon and Security Guard: Selection is made through a Viva-Voce test. For all posts, candidates must produce their original certificates at the time of scrutiny/verification. Candidates holding educational certificates issued by boards/universities other than the BSE, CHSE, or universities of Odisha must submit an equivalent certificate issued by the relevant Board/Council/University of the State.

content_sections.heading: OSBC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must furnish self-attested true copies of the following documents along with the application, as applicable to the post applied for: Certificate of Matriculation examination (or equivalent) along with mark sheet Certificate of Graduation along with mark sheet (Assistant Secretary, Computer Assistant, Jr. Assistant, Jr. Stenographer) Certificate of Law Degree/Higher Education, and Certificate of Enrolment (Assistant Secretary only) Certificate of B.C.A. or equivalent qualification (Computer Assistant only) Certificate of P.G.D.C.A. or equivalent qualification (Jr. Assistant and Jr. Stenographer) Certificate of completion of a Stenography course from a recognized institution or ITI (Jr. Stenographer only) Certificate of Moral Character from any Gazetted Officer Certificate relating to SC/ST, where applicable Experience Certificate, where applicable (Assistant Secretary: from the concerned Bar Association; Computer Assistant and Jr. Stenographer: general experience certificate) Two current passport-size colour photographs

faq.question: Q1. What is OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from the Odisha State Bar Council inviting applications for contractual appointment to six posts — Assistant Secretary, Computer Assistant, Jr. Assistant, Jr. Stenographer, Peon, and Security Guard - totalling 9 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies in total: 1 Assistant Secretary, 1 Computer Assistant, 3 Jr. Assistant, 1 Jr. Stenographer, 2 Peon, and 1 Security Guard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for all posts is 22.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: a Law degree and 5 years of bar practice for Assistant Secretary; a Bachelor's degree with B.C.A. for Computer Assistant; a Bachelor's degree with P.G.D.C.A. for Jr. Assistant; B.A./B.Sc./B.Com with P.G.D.C.A. and shorthand/typing proficiency for Jr. Stenographer; and a Middle/High School pass with Odia as a subject for Peon and Security Guard.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35–40 years for Assistant Secretary, and 21–35 years for all other posts, as on 01.08.2026. A 5-year relaxation applies for SC/ST candidates and a 3-year relaxation for women candidates, except for the Assistant Secretary post, where no relaxation is specified.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the notification for any of the six posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill the prescribed application form (given in the notification, specific to each post) in block letters, attach self-attested documents and photographs, and submit it to the Odisha State Bar Council office, High Court Annex, Cuttack-753002, on or before 22.08.2026. The notification does not indicate an online application mode.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for OSBC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a written test and Viva-Voce for Assistant Secretary and Jr. Assistant; a shorthand, computer, and Viva-Voce test for Jr. Stenographer; and only a Viva-Voce test for Computer Assistant, Peon, and Security Guard.
